_comment: Sync page copy (T11.3a). problems: the last sync's status, by word. command_problems: a button press that failed, by word (nothing retries those). Pinned to sync_settings::problem_copy and command_copy by the desktop's tests and read by the UI mock. Shipped with the app: public copy only. device_name_too_long: the refusal of a computer name over 64 characters (T11.3db). remove_other: removing another computer from its row (T11.6c); {device} is the row's name, not_another is sync_settings::NOT_ANOTHER_DEVICE. unsendable_note: shown under the status when the last sync skipped queued items it could not read (damaged), which are then not counted as waiting (T12.77b8; sync_settings::UNSENDABLE_NOTE). refused_note: shown under the status when the last sync left queued items unsent because they cannot be sealed (over the size limit, or holding an audio file's signature), which are then not counted as waiting either (T14.43; sync_settings::refused_note); one for a count of 1, many with {count} filled.

problems.unreachable: The sync server could not be reached. Earshot will try again.
problems.server: The sync server gave an answer Earshot does not understand. Earshot will try again.
problems.unknown_device: This computer was removed from sync. Remove it here, then join again with a pairing code.
problems.key_mismatch: This sync server already belongs to other devices. Join it with a pairing code from one of them.
problems.update_needed: Another device uses a newer Earshot. Update Earshot on this computer to keep syncing.
problems.slow_down: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
problems.too_large: Something was too large for the sync server. Earshot will try again.
problems.clock_ahead: Some changes on this computer are dated more than a day in the future, so they were not sent. Check the date and time on this computer and on the sync server. Earshot will try again.
problems.bad_secret: That setup secret is not the server's.
problems.no_slot: That pairing code is not one the server holds. It may be used or out of date: show a new one on the other device.
problems.bad_code: That is not a pairing code. Check it and type it again.
problems.device_exists: This computer is already registered with the server. Set it up with the server's setup secret instead.
problems.address: The sync server's address is not usable. Remove this computer from sync and set it up again.
problems.vault: This computer's sync key is missing. Remove this computer from sync and set it up again.
problems.store: Earshot could not read or save its own data for sync. It will try again.
problems.internal: Something went wrong inside sync. Restart Earshot to try again.

unsendable_note: Some items on this computer are damaged and could not be sent, so they were skipped. Everything else syncs as usual.

refused_note.one: 1 item on this computer cannot be synced because it is too large or looks like audio, so it was not sent. Your other computers do not get it. Everything else syncs as usual.
refused_note.many: {count} items on this computer cannot be synced because they are too large or look like audio, so they were not sent. Your other computers do not get them. Everything else syncs as usual.

device_name_too_long: The name can have at most 64 characters.

remove_other.title: Remove {device} from sync?
remove_other.explained: It stops reaching your sync server and leaves this list. The meetings it already synced stay on your other computers. Removing it does not take back the sync key it already holds: if that computer is lost or no longer yours, also wipe it.
remove_other.not_another: That is not another of your computers. To remove this computer, use Remove this computer.
